decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline-related offer that uses existing capabilities and serves similar customers, it likely meets aspiration levels sufficiently to retain.
This pipe support bracket fits the firm's established technical competences and customer needs, so absent clear evidence of a performance shortfall management would keep it.

As a more distant single-model diversification into public waste bins, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and have its resources redirected to the growing core business or new development.

Although more distant from the core offer, this multi-model waste-bin-with-ashtray line still leverages fabrication and coating resources and can be carried with some slack while results remain acceptable but uncertain.
Outdoor public ashtrays are peripheral but still use existing metalworking and coating capabilities and can be kept for now unless performance clearly lags aspirations.
